sloka: न च अस्य महतीम् लक्ष्मीम् राज्य नाशो अपकर्षति ।लोक कान्तस्य कान्तत्वम् शीत रश्मेर् इव क्षपा ॥२-१९-३२॥
transliteration: na ca asya mahatīm lakṣmīm rājya nāśo apakarṣati ।loka kāntasya kāntatvam śīta raśmer iva kṣapā ॥2-19-32॥

translations.english: Rama was the beloved of the people. Loss of kingdom did not diminish his splendour just like night cannot diminish the splendour of the coolrayed Moon.
